restDays.title: Weekly rest days
restDays.hint: Tap a day to make it a rest day or a working day. Work on a rest day counts as overtime. A site without its own days follows the organisation's (faded).

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.hint: Work on a public holiday counts as overtime; the day is not counted as an absence or as leave.
holidays.empty: No holidays in the coming year yet.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.required: Enter the name and the date.

exceptions.title: Exceptional days
exceptions.hint: A day with other hours (for example, everyone leaves at 4 pm on Thursday) or a day off, for the organisation, a site or one person. With "no deduction", nothing is deducted for lateness or early leave that day.
exceptions.required: Enter the date and the reason.
